children: UAE-based developer Binghatti Holding is committed to completing 10 projects within the next four to five months, collectively worth 7.5 billion UAE dirhams ($2.04 billion), Chairman Muhammad BinGhatti told Bloomberg's Horizon Middle East & Africa.
"These projects are 94 percent sold and on average 80 percent collected," he said.
The company has already handed over three projects since June 2026 worth AED 1.8 billion, BinGhatti added.

This month Moody's Ratings had placed the developer's ratings on review for downgrade due to a deterioration in its liquidity profile and the uncertainty surrounding the timing and generation of cash flows over the next 12-18 months.

In July, BinGhatti Holding announced that its first half 2026 net profit rose 64 percent year-on-year (YoY) to AED 3 billion, while revenue increased 50 percent to AED 9.5 billion. Revenue backlog stood at AED 17.3 billion, while development backlog stood at AED 44.2 billion as of June 2026.

title: Binghatti Holding to hand over 10 projects in next five months: Report
